mentions.name: Personal Library App
mentions.description: This app is a personal library manager being specified for generation with AppSheet and Gemini, intended to implement the author's ideas about book classification and entity catalogs as part of library science work.
mentions.source_excerpt: Writing a specification for a personal library app in the hopes I can get AppSheet + Gemini to make one for me. I'm working on library science in general, so it will hopefully implement ideas I have about book classification and entity catalogs.
